name: Fighter
source: A stout warrior who defends the first floor of the dungeon. Her absolute defense can turn any physical attack, and she can even deflect and counter magical attacks. Although she may appear human at first glance, her ability to effortlessly wear extremely heavy armor is literally superhuman.
